About Me

Bridging backend systems
and AI-enabled products.

To me, software engineering is not only about shipping features. It is about organising requirements, data, interfaces, security, testing, and deployment into a system that can be understood and maintained.

Profile

I am currently pursuing a Master of Software Engineering at the University of Sydney, following a bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering. My project work spans Django and Spring Boot backends, modern web frontends, REST APIs, relational databases, authentication and access control, LLM applications, and software-verification agents.

I am especially interested in systems with clear business constraints: who may perform an action, how state changes safely, how concurrent requests remain consistent, how failures can be retried, and how AI output can be constrained by tools and evidence.

Internship interests

  • Full-stack Engineering

What I bring

  • Backend fundamentals: database design, APIs, authentication, authorisation, transactions, and exception handling.
  • End-to-end perspective: translating user flows into interfaces, frontend integration, testing, and deployment.
  • Responsible AI thinking: prompting, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and evidence boundaries without treating model output as fact.
  • Clear collaboration: documentation, reproducible environments, explicit ownership, and honest claims.
